Ethan / Marcus — reviewed the workbook and the aging. Quick notes:

- AR impact: applying the credit proportionally across INV-1102 (EUR 12,400), INV-1134 (EUR 7,800), INV-1199 (EUR 3,200) is fine from a customer reconciliation perspective. We will post a single AR credit memo that references all three invoice numbers.

- Revenue mapping: currently revenue for those invoices posted to product_subscription (ARR) for INV-1102 and product_usage for the others. If we apply the credit proportionally, we need to perform a revenue recognition adjustment to shift gross-to-net amounts in the month of original recognition (Jan) to keep revenue recognized consistent. I've added suggested debit/credit lines in the Drive sheet: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B_revmapping_sheet

- VAT: my read is that this remains outside-scope for Redwood (B2B reseller) if Nimbus provides a valid VAT number, but we need Nimbus to confirm their VAT id and whether they treated the purchases as reverse-charge. Sarah — can you confirm VAT id and whether the reseller reported VAT?

I'll draft the journal correction (JE) once Marcus confirms the GL codes and posting date.

Lauren Bishop
Accounting Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

- Debit AR: EUR 23,400 (credit memo applied across INV-1102/1134/1199)
- Credit Sales Revenue - product_subscription: EUR 10,800
- Credit Sales Revenue - product_usage: EUR 12,600
- Memo: Apply credit note 8427 across three invoices; reverse prior recognition as per layout in rev_mapping_workbook.xlsx

GL codes: AR 12001, Rev_SUBS 41010, Rev_USAGE 41100

I attached a patch with the JE template and the reversal calculation (journal_patch_JN-527.xlsx). Sarah — once you confirm VAT id and the reseller treatment, we'll proceed.

If Lauren signs off, I can enter JE-527 into the ledger on Monday and schedule a reversal in the next close run.
